newsitem.title: UK: NNPC raises March light crude price, cuts Forcados.
newsitem.headline: NNPC raises March light crude price, cuts Forcados.

text.p: Nigerian National Petroleum Corp (NNPC) on Thursday raised the price for March liftings of its light crude grades and cut the price for heavier crudes, traders said.
NNPC raised Bonny Light and Qua Iboe (BQ) prices for March by five cents from February to Dated Brent plus 58 cents.
It reduced the price of March Forcados cargoes by 21 cents to Dated Brent plus 47 cents.
One trader said the new prices were "bang in line with market expectations."
NNPC also raised prices for Escravos in March by eight cents to Dated Brent plus 52 cents and for Brass River by 14 cents to Dated Brent plus 59 cents.
Pennington went up by five cents to Dated Brent plus 93 cents.
Bonny Medium for March was reduced by 18 cents to Dated Brent plus 35 cents.
NNPC reduced the premium payable for deferred pricing of March liftings, 14 days after bill of lading, by five cents to 10 cents.
